churchReadersStandIn: These numbers are counted in this browser only, until the server is ready.
churchCreated: Church created. It is a draft: readers do not see it yet.
churchReadersHint: How many people opened this church's reading on each day. A number only: no names and no phone numbers. A reader is counted once a day on one browser. Days are counted in UTC.
churchPlanInvalidDay: Day {{day}} of the plan is not valid.
churchPlanSaved: Plan saved. It is now the plan of this church.
churchTextNeeded: Needed to switch on this church.
churchReadersEmpty: No readers counted in these days yet.
churchTextBlocked: This text is not cleared yet, so it cannot be chosen.
churchPlanNoneRead: This church has no reading plan yet.
churchReadersLoadFailed: Could not load the reader numbers.
churchAddressHint: The host name only, such as church.example.org. The first one is the main address.
churchStatusNote: Only an active church shows its look. Draft, paused and archived churches show a plain "Not available" page.
churchPlanLoadFailed: Could not load the reading plan. Try again.
churchColorHint: Leave empty for the default colours. Write it like #1f5f4a.
churchPlanEmpty: Paste or write the plan above. A plan has 1 to {{max}} days, and each day has 1 to 6 readings.
churchPlanText: The plan, one day on each line
churchTextNoOptions: No Bible text is listed for this language yet.
churchPlanNone: This church has no reading plan yet. A church cannot be switched on without one.
churchPlanTitleHint: Give at least one title. Readers see the title in their own language when it is given.
churchNotReady: Not ready to switch on. Missing: {{list}}.
churchReadOnly: Only church staff can save churches. You can look.
churchNameHint: Give at least one name. A language left empty shows the name of the default language.
churchTextHint: The Bible text this church reads in the Daily Bible, for each language. A text can be chosen only when it is public domain or written permission is recorded. A language without a choice keeps the default text.
churchTextLoadFailed: Could not load the list of Bible texts.
churchTextRemoved: This language now uses the default text.
churchesPreviewNotice: These churches are kept in this browser only until the server is ready.
churchPlanHint: The plan this church's Daily Bible follows. Write one day on each line. Put several readings of one day on the same line, separated by a semicolon or a comma. Use English book names and whole chapters. For a part of a chapter write (1/2). Lines copied from a spreadsheet can be pasted too.
churchTextLineHint: Says where the words come from. Readers see it.
churchPlanFixLines: Correct the lines listed above, then save.
churchesIntro: Set up a church's name, look, default language and web addresses. Only church staff can save.
churchMissingText: an approved Bible text for the default language
churchPlanProblem_tooManyDays: A plan has {{max}} days at most; this one has {{count}}.
churchPlanProblem_emptyDay: Line {{line}}: this day has no reading.
churchPlanProblem_dayNumber: Line {{line}}: the day number is {{given}}, but this is day {{expected}}. Days must follow in order.
churchPlanProblem_tooManyReadings: Line {{line}}: a day has {{max}} readings at most; this one has {{count}}.
churchPlanProblem_noBook: Line {{line}}: “{{text}}” has no book name. Write each reading with its book, for example Psalms 1; Psalms 2.
churchPlanProblem_unknownBook: Line {{line}}: “{{text}}” is not a book name we know. Use the English name, for example Psalms.
churchPlanProblem_noChapter: Line {{line}}: “{{text}}” needs a chapter, for example {{book}} 1.
churchPlanProblem_badPart: Line {{line}}: the part in “{{text}}” is not valid. Write it like (1/2), which means part 1 of 2, with 10 parts at most.
churchPlanProblem_range: Line {{line}}: “{{text}}” is a range. Write each chapter as its own reading, for example Genesis 1; Genesis 2.
churchPlanProblem_verse: Line {{line}}: “{{text}}” names a verse. A plan uses whole chapters, or a part of a chapter like (1/2).
churchErrCONFLICT_VERSION: Someone else saved first. Reload and try again.
churchErrADDRESS_TAKEN: This web address belongs to another church.
churchErrRATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait a minute.
churchErrUNAVAILABLE: Could not save. Nothing was changed. Try again.
churchErrTEXT_NOT_PERMITTED: This Bible text is not cleared yet.
churchErrPLAN_INVALID: A day in this plan is not valid.
churchProblemContrast: Not readable enough with text. Choose a stronger colour.
churchProblemTaken: This web address belongs to another church.
